newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Granite sees "record" Q4/FY '96.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Granite sees "record" Q4/FY '96.

text.p: Bank of Granite Corp said on Wednesday that earnings for the fourth quarter and year should reach a new record.
"(Chairman John Forlines) anticipates both quarterly and annual earnings to be at record levels," the company said in a statement.

Bank of Granite earned $3.2 million or $0.52 a share in the 1995 fourth quarter. It posted $11.5 million or $1.92 per share for the year. The Granite Falls, N.C.-based bank was due to report earnings on or about Jan. 13, 1997.
Also, the bank set a dividend of $0.09 per share, payable Jan. 31, 1997, to shareholders of record on Jan. 13, 1997.
